title: Georgian Language Benchmark Data
subtitle: Gold data for testing how well AI models know Georgian
description:
Evaluation items for the Georgian Language Benchmark on Kaggle: script and orthography, base-20 numbers, verb morphology, grammar judgment, chat Georgian, reasoning parity, language fidelity and cultural knowledge. Generated items come from deterministic scripts; hand-curated items were written and checked by a native speaker.

Code: https://github.com/georgekobaidze/georgian-language-benchmarks
